about: wb-vked (R694 follow-up of wb-4ap.14 landing 642, F1): bd's dependency-type source file, byte-exact. The deflated list is the raw-deflate compression of the git blob named beside it (git cat-file blob <blob> in the beads repository, never edited; the same blob is internal/types/types.go at the installed bd's commit and at both revisions in sameBlobAt). test/workbench-beads-observer.test.ts inflates it, checks its byte length, recomputes its git blob id and reads WellKnownDependencyTypes() and AffectsReadyWork() from it, so its BD_DEPENDENCY_TYPES, EDGED_BD_TYPES and OWNERSHIP_READINESS_CAUSE_TYPES literals are read against bd's own source, not only against themselves. Stored compressed (its bytes as a number list) so bd's source and comments are never read as Pi's own text by the censuses that walk the tree. The observer under test never reads it.
